Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct anomaly where the values spike significantly higher than the rest of the data (which mostly fluctuates between 0 and 5 mm). This spike reaches values above 10 mm.

Looking at the x-axis ("Original daily index"), this anomalous range starts just after the 500 mark and ends before the 550 mark. Specifically:
- The rise begins around x = 510.
- The peak activity lasts until about x = 535.
- By x = 540, the values have returned to the normal baseline range.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is approximately [510, 535].

[[510, 535]]
